title: Data Science Agent — Study 3 reviewer usability, one reviewer record
description: Web plan §12 Study 3, protocol in STUDY3_REVIEWER_USABILITY.md. One JSON document per reviewer. No field is pre-filled by the project; every value comes from a real session. Not conducted yet (PENDING EXTERNAL ACTOR).

preflight_offline_check_passed.description: The coordinator ran the repository's zero-network-request acceptance on this exact file before the session, per protocol §3.

is_project_author.description: Must be false for the session to count.

opened_as.description: Browser and file:// vs hosted URL, in the reviewer's own terms — how the file was opened is part of what R-07 claims.

help_events.description: Times the coordinator answered a question, per protocol §4 preamble.

report_file.description: The offline report file's name as handed over.

claims.description: The claims as the reviewer themselves segmented them, in their order; one timed attempt per claim.

claim_verbatim.description: The claim as the reviewer phrased it; their segmentation is data.

drill_down_used.description: Whether an in-page expansion or anchor was followed during the attempt.

reason_verbatim.description: Required in the reviewer's words when the outcome is not_verified_within_5m.

could_not_verify_verbatim.description: The answer to the mandatory closing question, protocol §4.4 — names at least one claim, or states that every claim verified.

words_recorded.description: The reviewer consented to their own words being recorded and archived.

raw_archive_path.description: Where the session's raw record lives, appended under external-validation/ in a dated file.
